source: Periksa batas waktu pengembalian di kebijakan resmi, lalu baca ulang jawabannya.
english: Check the return deadline in the official policy, then reread the response.

source: Periksa jadwal, perkiraan biaya, dan syarat berkas sebelum mengisi formulir.
english: Check the schedule, estimated fees, and document requirements before filling in the form.

source: Periksa sumber sebelum menghapus data. Sebagian ID yang berulang bisa valid, misalnya jika satu pesanan berisi beberapa item.
english: Check the source before deleting any data. Some repeated IDs are valid, for example when one order contains multiple items.

source: Perkecil jarak antar elemen supaya semua tetap muat dalam satu layar.
english: Reduce spacing between elements so everything still fits on one screen.

source: Permintaan tersimpan. Tim PMB akan menindaklanjutinya lewat WhatsApp.
english: Request received. The admissions team will follow up on WhatsApp.
The quiz questions are coming soon.

source: Pesan stok untuk satu bulan berdasarkan perkiraan tim.
english: Order a month’s worth of stock based on the team’s estimates.

source: Pesanan lewat aplikasi banyak, tetapi sebagian pelanggan batal saat mengetahui biaya kirim. Tim hanya punya waktu mencoba satu perubahan minggu ini. Percobaan mana yang paling berguna?
english: The app gets plenty of orders, but some customers abandon their order when they see the delivery fee. The team has time to test one change this week. Which experiment would be most useful?

source: Peserta melihat karya mahasiswa, mengikuti workshop, dan berdiskusi mengenai pilihan program studi serta prospek kerja. Rangkaian kunjungan memberi kesempatan bagi siswa untuk bertanya langsung tentang pengalaman kuliah.
english: Participants viewed student work, joined workshops, and discussed study options and career prospects. The visit gave students a chance to ask directly about university life.
Find out where your skills stand

source: Petakan satu tugas berulang yang bisa dibantu AI. Tentukan data apa yang aman dipakai dan bagian mana yang perlu diperiksa manusia.
english: Map out a repetitive task that AI could help with. Decide which data is safe to use and which steps need human review.

source: Piko yang gesit menggambarkan keberanian mencoba ide dan menyesuaikannya dari respons pelanggan.
english: Quick on his feet, Piko represents the courage to test ideas and adjust them based on customer feedback.

source: Pilih desain milik anggota yang paling senior.
english: Choose the design by the most senior team member.
Choose a Track and Gather Your Information

source: Pilih satu hambatan yang muncul berulang. Perbaiki letak informasi atau label tombol, lalu ulangi tugas yang sama untuk melihat apakah langkahnya menjadi lebih mudah.
english: Choose one recurring obstacle. Adjust the position of the information or the button label and repeat the same task to see whether it is easier.

source: Pilih topik yang sesuai dan ceritakan pertanyaanmu. Sertakan email serta nomor WhatsApp agar tim bisa menindaklanjuti.
english: Choose a topic and tell us how we can help. Include your email and WhatsApp number so the team can follow up.

source: Pilih yang mendapat suara terbanyak dari tim desain.
english: Choose the design that gets the most votes from the design team.

source: Pindahkan tombol ke lokasi yang mudah ditemukan dengan label jelas, lalu uji tugas pembayaran lagi.
english: Move the button somewhere easy to find, give it a clear label, and test the payment task again.
Scan your original Family Card (Kartu Keluarga or KK).

source: Pindai KTP asli bagi yang sudah memilikinya. Formulir menyediakan pengisian NIK dari KK bagi yang belum memiliki KTP.
english: Scan your original national identity card (KTP) if you already have one. If you do not have a KTP, you can enter the national identification number (NIK) from your Family Card (KK) on the form.

source: Pindai rapor kelas X dan XI yang sudah dilegalisasi.
english: Scan the certified copies of your Grade 10 (X) and Grade 11 (XI) report cards.

source: Potongan 50% USP dan 100% SKS. Syaratnya antara lain tiga besar olimpiade sains tingkat provinsi, rata-rata rapor di atas 90, bukti prestasi, TPA minimal 550, dan wawancara.
english: Offers 50% off USP and a 100% waiver of SKS fees. Requirements include a top-three finish in a provincial science olympiad, a school report-card average above 90, proof of achievement, a TPA score of at least 550, and an interview.

source: Potongan 50% USP serta 50% SPP dan SKS. Orang tua mengajar aktif di SMA minimal 10 tahun. Siapkan surat pengangkatan, ikuti wawancara, dan raih TPA minimal 500.
english: Offers 50% off USP and 50% off SPP and SKS. A parent must have been actively teaching at a senior high school for at least 10 years. Provide a letter of appointment, attend an interview, and score at least 500 on the Academic Potential Test (TPA).

source: Potongan USP 10%. Tanggal pembukaan menunggu konfirmasi tim PMB.
english: 10% USP discount. The admissions team has yet to confirm the opening date.

source: Potongan USP 20%. Tanggal pembukaan menunggu konfirmasi tim PMB.
english: 20% USP discount. The admissions team has yet to confirm the opening date.

source: Potongan USP 30%. Tanggal pembukaan menunggu konfirmasi tim PMB.
english: 30% USP discount. The admissions team has yet to confirm the opening date.

source: Potongan USP 40%. Konfirmasi jadwal dengan tim PMB sebelum membayar.
english: 40% USP discount. Confirm the schedule with the admissions team before paying.

source: Potongan USP 50%. Rincian nominal ada pada tabel biaya.
english: 50% USP discount. See the fee table for the amount.

source: Pra-pendaftaran mencatat minat dan data awalmu. Tim PMB akan mengarahkan tahap kelengkapan dan penerimaan resmi.
english: The pre-application records your interest and basic information. The admissions team will guide you through completing your application and the formal admissions process.

source: Pra-pendaftaran sedang tidak dibuka. Lihat jadwal gelombang atau hubungi tim PMB melalui halaman Kontak.
english: Pre-registration is closed. Check the admissions schedule or contact the admissions team.

source: Pra-pesan pada harga nyata menguji kesediaan membayar. Minat dalam survei atau jumlah tayangan memberi petunjuk, tetapi belum menunjukkan keputusan membeli.
english: Taking pre-orders at the actual price tests willingness to pay. Survey interest and view counts provide clues. A pre-order shows whether someone will commit to buying.
Merit Track I offers a 50% USP discount.
Merit Track II offers a 40% USP discount.
Faculty profiles will be available soon.

source: Program Enrichment 2, Pancasila, dan Bahasa Inggris.

Program ini membekali peserta dengan pemanfaatan teknologi AI dan kegiatan edukasi untuk komunitas kampus. Pengalaman Innani menunjukkan bagaimana mahasiswa dapat mulai menjajal program di luar kelas sejak awal kuliah.
english: The program teaches participants how to use AI and organise educational activities for their campus communities. Innani’s experience shows how students can explore opportunities outside class as early as their first semester.

source: Promosi A menghasilkan 20 pesanan dari 100 pengunjung. Promosi B menghasilkan 40 pesanan dari 400 pengunjung. Promosi mana yang lebih sering mengubah pengunjung menjadi pembeli?
english: Promotion A generates 20 orders from 100 visitors. Promotion B generates 40 orders from 400 visitors. Which promotion converts visitors into buyers at a higher rate?
Develop a strategy for a small business

source: Rara mencatat ide di tabletnya dan mengajak tim melihat produk dari sisi pengguna.
english: Rara sketches ideas on her tablet and helps the team see the product from the user’s perspective.

source: Rara mulai dari kebutuhan pelanggan, lalu memilih ide bisnis yang bisa diuji.
english: Rara starts with customer needs and chooses a business idea the team can test.

source: Rata-rata rapor Matematika dan Bahasa Inggris di atas 75 serta TPA minimal 450. Potongan 75% USP dan biaya 6 SKS.
english: Applicants need an average school report-card grade above 75 in Mathematics and English and a TPA score of at least 450. Benefits include 75% off USP and a discount on fees for 6 credits (SKS).

source: Rata-rata rapor Matematika dan Bahasa Inggris di atas 85 serta TPA minimal 500. Potongan 50% USP dan biaya 10 SKS.
english: Applicants need an average school report-card grade above 85 in Mathematics and English and a TPA score of at least 500. Benefits include 50% off USP and a discount on fees for 10 credits (SKS).
Regular Track I offers a 30% USP discount.
Regular Track II offers a 20% USP discount.
Regular Track III offers a 10% USP discount.

source: Revisi yang baik mengatasi dua hambatan yang ditemukan sekaligus. Uji pada perangkat kecil untuk memastikan tombol terjangkau dan teks terbaca.
english: A good revision addresses both problems you found. Test it on a small device to make sure people can tap the button and read the text.
Educational background will be added soon.

source: Rp10.000, setelah bahan dan kemasan dikurangi.
english: Rp10,000, after deducting ingredients and packaging.

source: Rp12.000, karena hanya biaya bahan yang dikurangi.
english: Rp12,000, because only the cost of ingredients is deducted.

source: Rp25.000, karena itu uang yang dibayar pelanggan.
english: Rp25,000, because that is what the customer pays.

source: Rp7.000, setelah bahan, kemasan, dan platform dikurangi.
english: Rp7,000, after deducting ingredients, packaging, and the platform fee.

source: Rubah yang cepat membaca situasi melambangkan cara berpikir strategis.
english: This quick-thinking fox represents the ability to read a situation and think strategically.
BACHELOR'S DEGREE IN DIGITAL BUSINESS MANAGEMENT

source: S1 MANAJEMEN BISNIS DIGITAL · ISTTS SURABAYA
english: BSC IN DIGITAL BUSINESS MANAGEMENT · ISTTS SURABAYA

source: Saat mencoba prototipe toko, empat dari lima pengguna berhenti karena tidak menemukan tombol bayar. Perubahan apa yang paling tepat diuji berikutnya?
english: While testing a store prototype, four out of five users stopped because they couldn’t find the payment button. Which change should you test next?

source: Saya akan membandingkan pesanan per pengunjung, tetapi belum memilih promosi.
english: I would compare orders per visitor, but I would hold off on choosing a promotion.

source: Sebuah promosi membawa 20 pesanan dari 100 kunjungan. Promosi lain membawa 40 pesanan dari 400 kunjungan. Rasio konversinya masing-masing 20% dan 10%.
english: One promotion generated 20 orders from 100 visits. Another generated 40 orders from 400 visits. Their conversion rates were 20% and 10%, respectively.
Ready to become a digital business strategist?

source: Siapkan nama lengkap, kota, email, WhatsApp, nama dan jurusan sekolah, serta tahun lulus. Daftar berkas tahap resmi tersedia di bagian persyaratan.
english: Have your full name, city, email, WhatsApp number, school name, school major or track, and graduation year ready. The Requirements section lists the documents for the formal application stage.

source: Siapkan nama, jurusan dan tahun lulus sekolah, email, serta nomor WhatsApp aktif. Nomor registrasi muncul setelah formulir terkirim.
english: Have your name, school major or track and graduation year, email address, and active WhatsApp number ready. A registration number will appear after you submit the form.

source: Siapkan NISN, data sekolah, serta data orang tua atau wali untuk melengkapi formulir resmi.
english: Have your national student identification number (NISN), school details, and parent or guardian details ready for the official form.

source: Siswa dari SMAK Santa Maria dan SMAK Frateran mengenal perkuliahan lewat workshop, tur kampus, dan pameran karya.
english: Students from SMAK Santa Maria and SMAK Frateran explored university life through workshops, campus tours, and a showcase of student work.

source: Survei apakah calon pelanggan tertarik jika layanan ini tersedia.
english: Survey prospective customers to see whether they would be interested if the service were available.

source: Tambah anggaran iklan supaya lebih banyak calon pembeli datang.
english: Increase the advertising budget to attract more potential buyers.

source: Tambah gambar di bagian atas halaman supaya pengguna tertarik.
english: Add an image at the top of the page to catch users’ attention.

source: Tampilkan estimasi ongkir lebih awal dan bandingkan tingkat penyelesaian pesanan sebelum dan sesudahnya.
english: Show an estimated delivery fee earlier and compare order completion rates before and after the change.

source: Tandai semua ID berulang dan hitung jumlahnya untuk melihat besarnya masalah.
english: Flag and count all repeated IDs to see how widespread the issue is.

source: Tanggal Jalur Prestasi mengikuti pengumuman penerimaan kampus. Portal administrasi mencantumkan tahun berbeda untuk periode itu. Konfirmasi jadwal dengan tim PMB sebelum mengatur pendaftaran atau pembayaran.
english: Merit Track dates follow the campus admissions announcement. The administration portal lists a different year for that period. Confirm the schedule with the admissions team before arranging your application or making a payment.

source: Tanyakan hal yang ingin kamu tahu tentang perkuliahan, kurikulum, atau pendaftaran.
english: Ask us about studying at ISTTS, the curriculum, or admissions.

source: Tanyakan kepada beberapa calon pengguna desain mana yang terasa lebih mudah.
english: Ask a few prospective users which design feels easier to use.
Standard rate for the MBD undergraduate program.

source: Tatapan Kiko yang tajam menggambarkan kebiasaan memeriksa bukti sebelum menarik kesimpulan.
english: Kiko’s sharp gaze represents the habit of checking the evidence before drawing conclusions.

source: Tawarkan pra-pesan terbatas dengan harga nyata dan catat berapa yang bersedia membayar.
english: Offer a limited number of pre-orders at the actual price and record how many people are willing to pay.

source: Tawarkan satu menu dengan harga dan jam pengambilan yang jelas lewat formulir singkat. Catat jumlah orang yang melihat penawaran dan jumlah orang yang benar-benar memesan.
english: Use a short form to offer one meal with a clear price and pickup time. Record how many people see the offer and how many actually order.

source: Telusuri ID yang berulang ke data sumber, pisahkan duplikat dari pesanan sah, lalu hitung ulang.
english: Trace the repeated IDs back to the source data, separate duplicate entries from valid orders, then recount.

source: Temukan contoh artikel dengan langkah praktis untuk menguji ide, membaca data, dan merancang produk.
english: Find practical articles on testing ideas, interpreting data, and designing products.

source: Temukan jalur masuk, berkas, jadwal, biaya kuliah, dan beasiswa MBD. Siapkan data yang dibutuhkan untuk mulai pra-pendaftaran.
english: Explore MBD admission tracks, required documents, application dates, tuition fees, and scholarships. Get your information ready to start a pre-application.

source: Tentukan terlebih dulu berapa pesanan yang cukup untuk mencoba putaran berikutnya. Jika banyak orang tertarik tetapi sedikit yang memesan, tanya alasannya sebelum mengubah harga atau menambah menu.
english: Decide in advance how many orders would justify another round. If many people show interest but few place an order, ask why before changing the price or adding dishes.
Publish the response if it sounds convincing.

source: Tertarik belajar ini di MBD ISTTS?
english: Interested in studying this at MBD ISTTS?

source: Tiga gelombang reguler dengan tarif USP berbeda. Pilihan pra-pendaftaran mengikuti jadwal gelombang yang dikonfirmasi.
english: There are three Regular Track rounds, each with a different USP rate. Pre-application options follow the confirmed schedule for each round.

source: Tiga sudut pandang untuk memahami cara bisnis digital berkembang.
english: Three perspectives on how digital businesses grow.

source: Tim ingin memakai AI untuk mengelompokkan keluhan pelanggan. File berisi nama, nomor telepon, dan isi keluhan. Cara kerja mana yang paling tepat?
english: The team wants to use AI to group customer complaints. The file contains names, phone numbers, and the text of each complaint. Which approach is best?

source: Tim mau otomatis mengirim pesan pengingat pembayaran. Sebagian status pembayaran terlambat diperbarui. Bagaimana cara menguji otomatisasi itu?
english: The team wants to send payment reminders automatically. Some payment statuses are updated late. How would you test the automation?

source: Tim PMB akan memandu kelengkapan data dan tahap penerimaan. Ikuti instruksi resmi sebelum melakukan pembayaran.
english: The admissions team will guide you through completing your information and the admissions process. Follow the official instructions before making a payment.

source: Tim punya ide layanan antar bekal di kampus, tetapi belum tahu apakah mahasiswa mau membayar. Anggarannya cukup untuk satu percobaan kecil. Apa yang kamu pilih?
english: The team has an idea for a campus meal delivery service but doesn’t know whether students would pay for it. The budget covers one small experiment. Which would you choose?

source: Tulis dua cara menarik pelanggan untuk sebuah toko. Bandingkan biaya, margin, dan alasan pelanggan memilih masing-masing cara.
english: Write down two ways a store could attract customers. Compare costs and margins, and consider why customers would respond to each approach.

source: Ubah ilustrasi judul dengan versi resolusi lebih tinggi.
english: Replace the header illustration with a higher-resolution version.

source: Ubah logo agar pembeli lebih percaya pada merek.
english: Change the logo so buyers trust the brand more.

source: Uji alur checkout dengan tiga tugas sederhana
english: Test a checkout flow with three simple tasks

source: Uji beberapa pesanan reguler dan sediakan tombol berhenti manual.
english: Test a few routine orders and provide a manual stop button.

source: Uji contoh pembayaran berhasil, gagal, dan tertunda; tahan pesan untuk status meragukan sampai diperiksa.
english: Test successful, failed, and pending payments. Hold reminders when the status is uncertain until it has been checked.

source: Uji jalur normal dan kondisi bermasalah. Menahan kasus meragukan mengurangi risiko pelanggan yang sudah membayar menerima pengingat yang salah.
english: Test the normal flow and any conditions that can cause problems. Holding uncertain cases for review reduces the risk of sending reminders to customers who have already paid.

source: Uji tugas langsung mengukur tujuan desain. Preferensi tetap berguna, tetapi keberhasilan menemukan produk dan waktu yang dibutuhkan memberi bukti yang lebih relevan.
english: A task-based test measures the design goal directly. User preferences are useful, and completion rates and task time give more relevant evidence about how easily users find products.

source: Uli mencoba AI untuk merangkum masukan pelanggan, lalu memeriksa apakah hasilnya akurat.
english: Uli tries using AI to summarise customer feedback and then checks its accuracy.

source: Uli yang gemar membaca melambangkan kebiasaan belajar dan memeriksa kembali jawaban.
english: Uli loves to read and represents the habit of learning and double-checking answers.

source: Umumkan bahwa promosi berhasil karena angka gabungan naik.
english: Announce that the promotion succeeded because the combined total went up.

source: Unggah semua data ke alat AI publik agar ringkasannya lengkap.
english: Upload all the data to a public AI tool to get a complete summary.

source: Untuk mengelompokkan tema, identitas pelanggan biasanya tidak diperlukan. Teks bebas juga dapat memuat identitas dan hasil AI tetap perlu ditinjau.
english: Customer identities are usually unnecessary when grouping complaints by theme. Free text can also contain identifying information, and the AI’s output still needs review.

source: Urut dari skor terendah. Pilih satu latihan untuk dicoba.
english: These exercises start with your lowest-scoring skill. Choose one to try.

source: USP adalah uang sumbangan pendidikan. Biaya kuliah paket mencakup SPP dan SKS per semester.
english: USP is the education contribution fee. The tuition package covers the semester tuition fee (SPP) and credit fees (SKS) for each semester.

source: Waduh, halaman ini tidak ada di peta strategiku.
english: This page isn’t on my map.

source: Wawancarai beberapa pelanggan yang batal untuk memahami keluhan tentang biaya.
english: Interview several customers who abandoned their orders to understand their concerns about the fee.
Great, we have received your pre-application!
